# MDL006: mdl-unresolved-ref

A reference resolves to no entity, or to an entity of the wrong kind.

Covers flow endpoints, claim operands, contract references, boundary flows, exception targets and `extend` targets.

## Examples

### MDL006 unresolved reference / A flow to a node that does not exist fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted {
}
flow f : a -> nowhere {
  label Public;
}
```

### MDL006 unresolved reference / A flow between declared nodes is clean #2 (line 18) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted {
}
node b : trusted {
}
flow f : a -> b {
  label Public;
}
```
